inspiration: Water glint: one sun-coloured specular term from the half-vector between light and view, raised to one exponent (crates/benilla-assets/src/shaders/liquid.wgsl lines 79-90). The view vector is per vertex (lines 82-84).

Depth-ramp water: a 64-row table blended linearly between a shallow and a deep colour, with the depth coordinate interpolated between two rows (liquid.wgsl lines 164-186; blend at line 169). Ocean water darkens its last row in swatch_row.
Glow pass: downsample first, then a separable four-tap Gaussian in horizontal and vertical passes, then combine (crates/benilla-world/src/shaders/ffx_glow.wgsl lines 31, 42-46, 50-58).
Heat ripple: a repeating lookup texture, rotated and scrolled over time, becomes a pixel offset that warps the screen (ffx_glow.wgsl lines 130-138). Good for spell impacts and heat shimmer.

Blend presets: a named set of blend states for effects (additive, alpha, opaque, alpha-key, multiply, mod2x), each explained in its comment (crates/benilla-world/src/shaders/wow_effect.wgsl lines 6-12).
Spell and enchant visuals are listed as particles, ribbons and weapon enchant glows (README.md lines 25-27). Not read in code; category-level only.

briefs.label: Single sun glint on water
briefs.why: One signature sparkle: a tight glint that moves with the view. Reads at 375 wide as a shine on the surface.
briefs.keep: KEPT: one half-vector glint with one exponent; glint colour from the sun.
briefs.change: CHANGED: tint and exponent per biome; our own water colour set; a glint that also responds to a ripple, not just the view.

briefs.label: Impact heat ripple
briefs.why: Silhouette-free effect that reads as heat or force: the screen bends for a moment around a spell impact.
briefs.keep: KEPT: a scrolled, rotated lookup that becomes a pixel offset; the offset is small and short-lived.
briefs.change: CHANGED: our own ripple pattern, a different amplitude curve, and a ring shape centred on the impact point.

briefs.label: Depth-ramp water
briefs.why: Water reads as depth at a glance: shallow is light and open, deep is dark. One signature look, cheap on a phone.
briefs.keep: KEPT: a short ramp blended by depth; ocean rows darkened at the bottom.
briefs.change: CHANGED: our palette and row count; a ramp from a biome colour, not two fixed endpoints.

briefs.label: Downsample-blur glow
briefs.why: A soft halo around bright effects (fire, magic) at low cost.
briefs.keep: KEPT: downsample first, then separable horizontal and vertical blur, then combine.
briefs.change: CHANGED: our own kernel weights and a bloom colour per effect; a half-res pass at most.
